# NDV · Neurodivergence

> Luxury for the sensitive woman. Curated womenswear, lingerie, second-skin shapewear, weighted sanctuary bedding, and tactile objects engineered to soften external stimuli — designed for neurodivergent women aged 18–55 across the autism, ADHD, and sensory-processing spectrum.

## Brand
- Name: NDV (Neurodivergence)
- Audience: women, 18–55, neurodivergent, luxury buyers
- Aesthetic: Soft Rose Noir — hushed, sensory-friendly, no harsh contrast

## The Five Houses
- /category/atelier — silk, cashmere, fluid tailoring with lined seams
- /category/intimates — wireless bralettes, sensory-soft lingerie, chemises
- /category/shapewear — seamless second-skin shaping, no compression bite
- /category/bedding — weighted blankets, mulberry-silk sleep, sanctuary linens
- /category/adornment — tactile jewelry, worry stones, quiet electronics

## Key pages
- / — homepage, manifesto, full edit
- /cart — review selection
- /product/{handle} — product detail, sizing (US/UK/EU/AU/JP), add to cart

## Concierge
An on-site AI concierge assists with sizing, fabric questions, and sensory profile. Hushed tone, brief, never upsells.

## Checkout
Hosted Shopify checkout. Global shipping. Returns per policy.
